商店街に行くと、何故かバニー服姿の翠蘭が、\n疲れた表情で休憩していた。:
When I went to the shopping district, I found Cuilan taking a break,
looking worn out and, for some reason, wearing a bunny outfit.
なんか疲れてるみたいだけど……どうしたんだ？\nそんなバニー服姿で。:
You look pretty tired... What happened?
And what's with the bunny outfit?
……罰ゲームで、買い出しをすることになったのですが……\n何故か店員と思われて、:
...I had to go shopping as a penalty for losing a game...
But people keep mistaking me for a shop assistant and stopping me...
毎回訂正したり、分かる場所なら案内をしたり……そうしていたら、\n全然自分の買い:
I keep having to explain, or give directions if I know the place...
It's taking so long that I can't get my own shopping done.
頼りやすい証拠だな: It means people feel they can rely on you.
（あー、バニー姿で商店街にいるとイベントスタッフに見えるよな。\nそれに、翠蘭っ:
(Oh, right. A bunny outfit in the shopping district would make her look like event staff.
And Cuilan's pretty easy to approach...)
……その評価は喜んでいいんですか？: ...Am I supposed to be pleased about that?
まあ、頼りにくいよりはいいんじゃないか？\nそれに、そんな翠蘭がいるからカオスメ:
Well, it's better than being unapproachable, isn't it?
Besides, Chaos Maiden holds together because you're there, Cuilan.
どうした？ 俺の言葉はあんまり気に入らなかったか？: What's wrong? Didn't like what I said?
違います……そんな言葉で、結構嬉しくて許せるようになった、\n自分がチョロくて嫌:
No... Your words actually cheered me up enough to let it all go.
I'm just annoyed with myself for being so easy to win over.
恥ずかしそうな表情を浮かべて、\nそんな風にいう翠蘭を可愛らしく思うのだった。:
The embarrassed look on her face as she said that
made Cuilan seem all the more adorable.
……そうですね。バニー服なんて目立ちますからね。\n危ない人だと思って、声をかけ:
...You're right. A bunny outfit does stand out.
I'd thought people would find me suspicious and steer clear...
そこは、翠蘭の人徳だろうな。: That just goes to show what a good person you are, Cuilan.
……そんな人徳だったら、なくていいんですがね。\nまあ、仕方ありません……罰ゲー:
...If that's what being a good person gets me, I'd rather not be one.

苦笑しながら、ユリアたちに頼まれた買い出しのために、\n商店街に消えていくのだっ:
With a wry smile, she disappeared into the shopping district
to finish the shopping Julia and the others had asked her to do.
